follow-up time: Up to the end of the second trimester
cohort: 100 pregnant women with subchorionic or retroplacental hematoma shown in ultrasound compared with 200 pregnant women without hematoma in the first trimester, at Elwiya Maternity Teaching Hospital
finding: The presence and the characteristic of an intrauterine hematoma during the first trimester may identify a population of patients at increased risk of adverse pregnancy outcome.
mod_finding: The cesarean section rate was higher in the group with intrauterine hematoma compared to the control group.
